deliverable.asserts: registered BlindOracle passport with NO provider track record yet — score is an honest zero, not a rating
deliverable.score_basis: Derived from settled BlindOracle jobs recorded in an append-only ledger. This is NOT the on-chain ERC-8004 ReputationRegistry aggregate, which is an unweighted mean movable by a single feedback and independently measured as Sybil-saturated (arXiv:2606.26028). ERC-8004 supplies identity here, not the score. An agent with no settled history scores an honest zero.
deliverable.verify_recipe: GET /v1/agents/<agent_id> on the onboarding registry; no BO credentials needed
